name: ClipMaster
description:
Clipboard history for GNOME Shell.

ClipMaster reads the clipboard so that it can offer a history of what you copied. Everything it stores stays on this computer: it has no network code and sends nothing anywhere.

* Text, links, colours, code and images, with thumbnails
* Search, favourites, pinned items and custom lists
* Private mode and a per-application exclusion list, for anything that should not be recorded
* A QR code for sharing a link or a note with a phone
* Twelve themes, or follow the system light and dark preference
* No keyboard shortcut is set by default; choose one in the preferences
